confidenceTiers.label: Operational High-Variance Lead
confidenceTiers.description: High physical separation (>5x scout visibility floor or >0.8 Hedges d effect size) consistently observed across starts.

confidenceTiers.label: Measurable Mechanical Variance
confidenceTiers.description: Measurable separation (2.5x-5x visibility floor) presenting an actionable visual difference to target on club film.

confidenceTiers.label: Baseline Tracked
confidenceTiers.description: Computer vision tracking established across outings; under continuous model expansion.

protocol.gameOrdering: game_date (officialDate from the game feed); game_pk does NOT order by date
protocol.validation_legacy_note: supersedes the earlier within-outing and random game-holdout splits
protocol.stratification: window geometry (set-anchored vs fixed lookback). NOT a windup/stretch delivery split: delivery_type label marks set detector stillness failure.
protocol.fdrFamily: one BH-FDR family per arm, q=0.10, spanning every situation, cue, contrast and stratum

meta.evNote: Package C (LIVE): tip cards ≥75%. Chart A–D on Evaluation shows C is the strictest. Per situation we report how many of the arsenal’s pitch types clear ≥75% one-vs-rest.
meta.pocNote: Savant CF is proof-of-concept video. Club sale deploys the same CV on private X1–X4 angles.

citations: Müller & Fadde, JMLD 2018 — anticipation ↔ SLG/OBP/K reduction
Fadde occlusion training — college AVG/OBP/SLG lift vs control

meta.contextNote: Tips are mined pooled and by strata: first only, any w/ runner on 2nd, third only, LHH vs RHH, set/stretch vs windup. Empty tip.context = all-situation tip.

provenance.rule: Pitcher and Catcher CV Detected Movement Leads (≥75% signal floor).

tierRules.liftDefinition: precision minus the base rate of the predicted pitch type among the validation pitches the contrast covers
tierRules.liftSignificance: one-sided binomial vs base rate, alpha=0.05
excludedAtEveryTier: retracted cues (pitchcom_*, cheek_motion_*, catcher_*, glove_angle_at_lift, glove_angle_at_set)
